CREATE TABLE board_columns (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      workspace_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      name text,
      position integer NOT NULL,
      kind text NOT NULL,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      archived_at integer,
      CONSTRAINT board_columns_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('todo', 'doing', 'review', 'blocked', 'done', 'custom'))
    )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX board_columns_live_position ON board_columns (workspace_id, position) WHERE archived_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX board_columns_builtin_kind ON board_columns (workspace_id, kind) WHERE kind <> 'custom'

CREATE TABLE cards (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      workspace_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      column_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES board_columns(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      position text NOT NULL,
      title text NOT NULL,
      description text,
      assignee_kind text,
      assignee_user_id text,
      created_by text NOT NULL,
      due_at integer,
      version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      updated_at integer NOT NULL,
      archived_at integer,
      CONSTRAINT cards_assignee_kind_check CHECK (assignee_kind IS NULL OR assignee_kind IN ('person', 'agent')),
      CONSTRAINT cards_assignee_pair_check CHECK ((assignee_kind IS NULL) = (assignee_user_id IS NULL))
    )
CREATE INDEX cards_ws_column_position_idx ON cards (workspace_id, column_id, position)

CREATE TABLE card_comments (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      workspace_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      card_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES cards(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      author_kind text NOT NULL,
      author_user_id text NOT NULL,
      body text NOT NULL,
      agent_task_id text,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      edited_at integer,
      deleted_at integer,
      CONSTRAINT card_comments_author_kind_check CHECK (author_kind IN ('person', 'agent'))
    )
CREATE INDEX card_comments_card_created_idx ON card_comments (card_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE card_events (
      id integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      workspace_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      card_id text,
      actor_kind text NOT NULL,
      actor_user_id text,
      type text NOT NULL,
      payload text NOT NULL,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT card_events_actor_kind_check CHECK (actor_kind IN ('person', 'agent', 'system'))
    )
CREATE INDEX card_events_ws_id_idx ON card_events (workspace_id, id)

CREATE TABLE board_audit (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      workspace_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      actor_user_id text NOT NULL,
      action text NOT NULL,
      target text NOT NULL,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT board_audit_action_check CHECK (action IN ('column.create', 'column.rename', 'column.archive', 'card.archive', 'card.restore', 'member.remove_from_board', 'leaver.decide'))
    )
CREATE INDEX board_audit_ws_created_idx ON board_audit (workspace_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE projects (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      organization_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      workspace_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      name text NOT NULL,
      visibility text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private',
      instructions text,
      created_by text NOT NULL,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      updated_at integer NOT NULL,
      archived_at integer,
      CONSTRAINT projects_visibility_check CHECK (visibility IN ('private', 'workspace'))
    )
CREATE INDEX projects_ws_archived_idx ON projects (workspace_id, archived_at)

CREATE TABLE project_members (
      project_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      user_id text NOT NULL,
      role text NOT NULL,
      added_by text NOT NULL,
      added_at integer NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (project_id, user_id),
      CONSTRAINT project_members_role_check CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member'))
    )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX project_members_one_owner ON project_members (project_id) WHERE role = 'owner'
CREATE INDEX project_members_user_idx ON project_members (user_id, project_id)

CREATE TABLE project_agents (
      project_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      agent_id text NOT NULL,
      brought_by text NOT NULL,
      added_at integer NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (project_id, agent_id, brought_by)
    )

CREATE TRIGGER projects_org_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON projects
      WHEN NEW.organization_id IS NOT (SELECT w.organization_id FROM workspaces w WHERE w.id = NEW.workspace_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'project_organization_mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER projects_org_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF organization_id, workspace_id ON projects
      WHEN NEW.organization_id IS NOT (SELECT w.organization_id FROM workspaces w WHERE w.id = NEW.workspace_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'project_organization_mismatch'); END

CREATE TABLE doc_versions (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id text NOT NULL,
      artifact_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES artifacts(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      version integer NOT NULL,
      spec text NOT NULL,
      kind text NOT NULL,
      changed_section_ids text NOT NULL,
      base_version integer,
      note text,
      author_kind text NOT NULL,
      author_user_id text,
      agent_id text,
      asked_by_user_id text NOT NULL,
      folded_authors text,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT doc_versions_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('document', 'workbook')),
      CONSTRAINT doc_versions_author_check CHECK (
        (author_kind = 'person' AND author_user_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_id IS NULL)
        OR (author_kind = 'agent' AND agent_id IS NOT NULL)
      ),
      CONSTRAINT doc_versions_version_check CHECK (version >= 1)
    )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX doc_versions_artifact_version ON doc_versions (artifact_id, version)
CREATE INDEX doc_versions_ws_artifact_idx ON doc_versions (workspace_id, artifact_id)

CREATE TABLE doc_proposals (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id text NOT NULL,
      artifact_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES artifacts(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      section_id text NOT NULL,
      base_version integer NOT NULL,
      section text NOT NULL,
      agent_id text NOT NULL,
      asked_by_user_id text NOT NULL,
      status text NOT NULL,
      kept_version integer,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      updated_at integer NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT doc_proposals_status_check CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'kept', 'discarded')),
      CONSTRAINT doc_proposals_base_check CHECK (base_version >= 1),
      CONSTRAINT doc_proposals_kept_check CHECK (
        (status = 'kept' AND kept_version IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'kept' AND kept_version IS NULL)
      )
    )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX doc_proposals_one_pending_section ON doc_proposals (artifact_id, section_id) WHERE status = 'pending'
CREATE INDEX doc_proposals_ws_artifact_idx ON doc_proposals (workspace_id, artifact_id)

CREATE TABLE media_proposals (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      organization_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      workspace_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      thread_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES threads(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      run_id text,
      user_id text NOT NULL,
      kind text NOT NULL,
      model text NOT NULL,
      sealed_request text NOT NULL,
      estimate_micros integer,
      estimate_currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
      status text NOT NULL,
      claimed_at integer,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      decided_at integer,
      CONSTRAINT media_proposals_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('image', 'video')),
      CONSTRAINT media_proposals_status_check CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'generated', 'skipped', 'expired', 'failed'))
    )
CREATE INDEX media_proposals_owner_idx ON media_proposals (organization_id, user_id, status)
CREATE INDEX media_proposals_thread_idx ON media_proposals (thread_id)

CREATE TABLE media_always_allow (
      organization_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      user_id text NOT NULL,
      kind text NOT NULL,
      allowed integer NOT NULL,
      updated_at integer NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, user_id, kind),
      CONSTRAINT media_always_allow_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('image', 'video'))
    )

CREATE TABLE gateway_managed_tokens (
      organization_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      gateway_token_id text NOT NULL,
      name text NOT NULL,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, gateway_token_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE company_quota_settings (
      organization_id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      enabled integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
      enabled_at integer,
      enabled_by text,
      company_cap_micros integer,
      version integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT company_quota_settings_enabled_check CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)),
      CONSTRAINT company_quota_settings_cap_check CHECK (company_cap_micros IS NULL OR company_cap_micros BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000),
      CONSTRAINT company_quota_settings_version_check CHECK (version >= 1)
    )

CREATE TABLE company_groups (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      organization_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      name text NOT NULL,
      created_by text NOT NULL,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      archived_at integer,
      CONSTRAINT company_groups_name_check CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0)
    )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX company_groups_org_name ON company_groups (organization_id, lower(name))

CREATE TABLE company_group_members (
      group_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES company_groups(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      user_id text NOT NULL,
      added_by text NOT NULL,
      added_at integer NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (group_id, user_id)
    )
CREATE INDEX company_group_members_user_idx ON company_group_members (user_id)

CREATE TABLE quota_allocations (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      organization_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      name text NOT NULL,
      scope_kind text NOT NULL,
      limit_micros integer NOT NULL,
      per_person_limit_micros integer,
      period_kind text NOT NULL,
      period_start integer,
      spent_micros integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
      held_micros integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
      models_mode text DEFAULT 'all' NOT NULL,
      priority integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
      status text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
      gateway_token_id text,
      version integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
      created_by text NOT NULL,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      updated_at integer NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocations_scope_check CHECK (scope_kind IN ('everyone', 'groups', 'people', 'admins')),
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocations_limit_check CHECK (limit_micros BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000),
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocations_per_person_check CHECK (per_person_limit_micros IS NULL OR per_person_limit_micros BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000),
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocations_period_check CHECK (period_kind IN ('lifetime', 'monthly')),
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocations_spent_check CHECK (spent_micros >= 0),
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocations_held_check CHECK (held_micros >= 0),
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocations_models_check CHECK (models_mode IN ('all', 'list')),
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocations_status_check CHECK (status IN ('active', 'paused', 'archived')),
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocations_version_check CHECK (version >= 1)
    )

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quota_allocations_live_everyone ON quota_allocations (organization_id)
      WHERE scope_kind = 'everyone' AND status <> 'archived'

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quota_allocations_live_admins ON quota_allocations (organization_id)
      WHERE scope_kind = 'admins' AND status <> 'archived'
CREATE INDEX quota_allocations_org_status_idx ON quota_allocations (organization_id, status)

CREATE TABLE quota_allocation_models (
      allocation_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES quota_allocations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      model_id text NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (allocation_id, model_id),
      CONSTRAINT quota_allocation_models_normal_check CHECK (model_id = lower(trim(model_id)) AND length(model_id) > 0)
    )

CREATE TABLE quota_assignments (
      allocation_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES quota_allocations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      subject_kind text NOT NULL,
      subject_id text NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (allocation_id, subject_kind, subject_id),
      CONSTRAINT quota_assignments_kind_check CHECK (subject_kind IN ('person', 'group'))
    )
CREATE INDEX quota_assignments_subject_idx ON quota_assignments (subject_kind, subject_id)

CREATE TABLE quota_person_usage (
      allocation_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES quota_allocations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      user_id text NOT NULL,
      period_start integer NOT NULL,
      spent_micros integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
      held_micros integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (allocation_id, user_id, period_start),
      CONSTRAINT quota_person_usage_spent_check CHECK (spent_micros >= 0),
      CONSTRAINT quota_person_usage_held_check CHECK (held_micros >= 0)
    )

CREATE TABLE quota_holds (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      allocation_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES quota_allocations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      organization_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      user_id text NOT NULL,
      run_id text NOT NULL,
      seq integer NOT NULL,
      boot_id text NOT NULL,
      kind text NOT NULL,
      model text NOT NULL,
      amount_micros integer NOT NULL,
      state text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
      settled_micros integer,
      cost_basis text,
      created_at integer NOT NULL,
      expires_at integer NOT NULL,
      closed_at integer,
      CONSTRAINT quota_holds_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('text', 'image', 'video', 'music', 'audio')),
      CONSTRAINT quota_holds_amount_check CHECK (amount_micros BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000),
      CONSTRAINT quota_holds_state_check CHECK (state IN ('open', 'settled', 'released', 'expired')),
      CONSTRAINT quota_holds_settled_check CHECK (settled_micros IS NULL OR settled_micros BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000),
      CONSTRAINT quota_holds_cost_basis_check CHECK (cost_basis IS NULL OR cost_basis IN ('reported', 'list_price', 'estimated', 'expired_charge')),
      CONSTRAINT quota_holds_seq_check CHECK (seq >= 0)
    )
CREATE INDEX quota_holds_allocation_state_idx ON quota_holds (allocation_id, state)
CREATE INDEX quota_holds_run_idx ON quota_holds (run_id, seq)
CREATE INDEX quota_holds_state_expiry_idx ON quota_holds (state, expires_at)
CREATE INDEX quota_holds_boot_idx ON quota_holds (boot_id, state)

CREATE TABLE quota_audit (
      id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      organization_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE cascade,
      tenant_id text NOT NULL,
      actor_user_id text NOT NULL,
      action text NOT NULL,
      allocation_id text,
      detail text,
      at integer NOT NULL,
      CONSTRAINT quota_audit_action_check CHECK (action IN ('quota.enable', 'quota.disable', 'quota.cap', 'allocation.create', 'allocation.update', 'allocation.pause', 'allocation.resume', 'allocation.archive', 'allocation.assign', 'allocation.unassign', 'group.create', 'group.delete', 'group.member.add', 'group.member.remove'))
    )
CREATE INDEX quota_audit_org_at_idx ON quota_audit (organization_id, at)

      WHEN NEW.tenant_id IS NOT (SELECT o.tenant_id FROM organizations o WHERE o.id = NEW.organization_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_tenant_mismatch'); END

      WHEN NEW.tenant_id IS NOT (SELECT o.tenant_id FROM organizations o WHERE o.id = NEW.organization_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_tenant_mismatch'); END

      WHEN NEW.tenant_id IS NOT (SELECT o.tenant_id FROM organizations o WHERE o.id = NEW.organization_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_tenant_mismatch'); END

      WHEN NEW.tenant_id IS NOT (SELECT o.tenant_id FROM organizations o WHERE o.id = NEW.organization_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_tenant_mismatch'); END

      WHEN NEW.tenant_id IS NOT (SELECT o.tenant_id FROM organizations o WHERE o.id = NEW.organization_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_tenant_mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER company_group_members_member_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON company_group_members
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM company_groups g
          JOIN organization_members m ON m.organization_id = g.organization_id
         WHERE g.id = NEW.group_id AND m.user_id = NEW.user_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_group_member_not_in_organization'); END

CREATE TRIGGER company_group_members_member_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF group_id, user_id ON company_group_members
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM company_groups g
          JOIN organization_members m ON m.organization_id = g.organization_id
         WHERE g.id = NEW.group_id AND m.user_id = NEW.user_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_group_member_not_in_organization'); END

CREATE TRIGGER quota_assignments_person_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON quota_assignments
      WHEN NEW.subject_kind = 'person' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM quota_allocations a
          JOIN organization_members m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id
         WHERE a.id = NEW.allocation_id AND m.user_id = NEW.subject_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_subject_not_member'); END

CREATE TRIGGER quota_assignments_person_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF allocation_id, subject_kind, subject_id ON quota_assignments
      WHEN NEW.subject_kind = 'person' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM quota_allocations a
          JOIN organization_members m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id
         WHERE a.id = NEW.allocation_id AND m.user_id = NEW.subject_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_subject_not_member'); END

CREATE TRIGGER quota_assignments_group_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON quota_assignments
      WHEN NEW.subject_kind = 'group' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM quota_allocations a
          JOIN company_groups g ON g.organization_id = a.organization_id
         WHERE a.id = NEW.allocation_id AND g.id = NEW.subject_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_group_outside_organization'); END

CREATE TRIGGER quota_assignments_group_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF allocation_id, subject_kind, subject_id ON quota_assignments
      WHEN NEW.subject_kind = 'group' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM quota_allocations a
          JOIN company_groups g ON g.organization_id = a.organization_id
         WHERE a.id = NEW.allocation_id AND g.id = NEW.subject_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_group_outside_organization'); END

CREATE TRIGGER quota_holds_allocation_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON quota_holds
      WHEN NEW.allocation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM quota_allocations a
         WHERE a.id = NEW.allocation_id AND a.organization_id = NEW.organization_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_allocation_outside_organization'); END

CREATE TRIGGER quota_holds_allocation_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF allocation_id, organization_id ON quota_holds
      WHEN NEW.allocation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (

        SELECT 1 FROM quota_allocations a
          JOIN organization_members m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id
         WHERE a.id = NEW.allocation_id AND m.user_id = NEW.user_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_subject_not_member'); END

CREATE TRIGGER organization_members_quota_removal AFTER DELETE ON organization_members
      BEGIN
        DELETE FROM company_group_members
         WHERE user_id = OLD.user_id
           AND group_id IN (SELECT id FROM company_groups WHERE organization_id = OLD.organization_id);
        DELETE FROM quota_assignments
         WHERE subject_kind = 'person' AND subject_id = OLD.user_id
           AND allocation_id IN (SELECT id FROM quota_allocations WHERE organization_id = OLD.organization_id);
      END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tenant_usage_hold_idx ON tenant_usage (hold_id) WHERE hold_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TRIGGER tenant_usage_allocation_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON tenant_usage
      WHEN NEW.allocation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM quota_allocations a
         WHERE a.id = NEW.allocation_id AND a.organization_id = NEW.organization_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_allocation_outside_organization'); END

CREATE TRIGGER tenant_usage_allocation_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF allocation_id, organization_id ON tenant_usage
      WHEN NEW.allocation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM quota_allocations a
         WHERE a.id = NEW.allocation_id AND a.organization_id = NEW.organization_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quota_allocation_outside_organization'); END
